question: My random article panel has only one eligible document. Should it show three empty cards?
expected: No. In the v2.1.1 development version the singleton sampling bug is fixed: one eligible document renders one card. show_random selects up to three from the existing tag-based pool at build time; eligibility thresholds and settings are unchanged. No new YAML option and no claim the fix is already in v2.1.0.

result.answer:
No, it should not show empty cards. In the v2.1.1 development version, a singleton pool rendering empty cards was fixed; if only one eligible candidate exists, it will render as one single card.

If you see an empty panel, it means no documents meet the required threshold (two shared tags in the same collection or three shared tags across collections). You can disable the panel entirely by setting `show_random: false` in your page front matter.

**Next Step:**
Check your documents' tags and collections to ensure they meet the shared-tag requirements for the panel to populate.

Sources:
* [Layouts and components](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/04-layouts#options)

question: Can I replace every include with include_cached to speed up builds? How are the layout components organized in the v2.1.1 development version?
expected: No blanket replacement. Pass all page-dependent inputs as include parameters; keep helpers that assign caller variables and custom hooks reading page context uncached. compress wraps minimal, then default or landingpage; archive/cloud/index layouts inherit default, search is standalone. Collection indexes share collection-documents and related/random share recommendations. Development caching reuses fixed footer content and cloud entries; comments keep page-specific inputs. No new configuration settings or claim this is released in v2.1.0.

result.answer:
No, you should not replace every include with `include_cached`. According to the documentation, cached includes must receive every page-dependent input as a parameter. You should use ordinary `include` for helpers that read page context, such as those assigning caller variables (like `canonical URL` or `page language`) or for custom hooks that read page context.

In the v2.1.1 development version, layout components are organized as follows:
* `compress` wraps `minimal`.
* `minimal` wraps `default` or `landingpage`.
* `archive`, `cloudtag`, `cloudcategory`, and `indexcategory` inherit from `default`.
* `search` is a standalone layout.
* Collection indexes share `components/collection-documents`.
* `related` and `random` panels share `components/recommendations`.

Sources: [Layout structure and include caching](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/04-layouts#layout-structure-and-components)
